#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

int main() {
    int n, limit;
    std::cin >> n >> limit;
    std::vector<int> data(n);
    std::vector<int> costArr(n, -1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> data[i];
    }
    int evenCount = 0, oddCount = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (data[i] % 2 == 0) {
            ++evenCount;
        } else {
            ++oddCount;
        }
        if (evenCount == oddCount && i != n - 1) {
            costArr[i] = std::abs(data[i + 1] - data[i]);
            evenCount = 0;
            oddCount = 0;
        }
    }
    std::sort(costArr.begin(), costArr.end());
    int total = 0, cutsMade = 0;
    for (int c : costArr) {
        if (c != -1) {
            total += c;
            if (total > limit) break;
            ++cutsMade;
        }
    }
    std::cout << cutsMade << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
